I Dare You

The only place on the Waterfront where there is an uninterrupted sunset view 365 days a year!!

Located on a waterfront near Gulf Shores Beach, we at Icehouse Tap Room have been serving up refreshingly-unique drinks and foods since 2000 in Baton Rouge, LA, and are excited to be opening Icehouse Tap Room in Gulf Shores!  

We offer a funky indoor space and a beachy outdoor space with an atmosphere that acts as a place for friends, wanderers, and adventurers to share a drink together as equals.  The previous business strived for an extremely local atmosphere and Icehouse Taproom will continue that tradition for the area!   We look forward to making new friends and seeing old friends.  We will have Live Entertainment and exciting Sporting Event watch parties!

We can't wait to see everyone!

ABOUT US

Icehouse Tap Room is located in the heart of Gulf Shores, a short walk from the beach.  Located directly behind the Original Oyster House on Hwy 59.  Exactly two (2) lights North of the hangout.  North, for those needing help is "that way".

Icehouse is a local neighborhood beach bar / restaurant on Little Lagoon offering the only uninterrupted sunset view over the water 365 days a year.  Surrounded by windows that make you question yourself on why you don't live here.  Icehouse offers a full menu, 24 beers on tap (the most on the island in Gulf Shores) featuring local options as well as beers from around the country.

Our experience comes from over 30 years of family-owned bars and restaurants.  We are not corporate driven at all and when you walk in, you'll know it!  Icehouse is open later than most businesses in the area as well as serving food later than most which means, after midnight.  So, if you are out and need a late-night hunger fix (that's food for all you youngsters), or cocktail, we will become friends really fast.  

Our menu ranges from burgers and wings to authentic Louisiana Boudin, including salads and a handful of Hispanic options including street tacos, chips, salsa and chimichangas (don't forget the crazy good smoked boudin gumbo on those cold days, it really makes you warm inside).  Most of our menu items are made to order and not frozen, and yes, the french fries are crinkle cut!  Don't forget to enjoy and possibly take home one of our love inspired, house made for a long time, sweet, spicy, garlic pepper BBQ sauce.  It's really kinda good on just about everything except, well everything!

Icehouse Tap Room has entertainment throughout the week as well as daytime happy hour specials on food and drinks.  Sorry but, you will have to find your own companionship, we can only provide so much.Icehouse Tap Room is OPEN seven, siete, sept, sieben, seacht, sette, septyni, cim (7) days a week at 11:00am for lunch.  Stop by the next time you are in Parad-ICE and find your new local hide-a-way watering hole in Gulf Shores, AL.
